item.title: 🔒 Glastonbury’s HABCO acquired by Alaskan corporation
item.description: Glastonbury-based aerospace manufacturer HABCO Industries has been acquired by Cook Inlet Region Inc.

item.title: 🔒 Investor bets on lease-up play with $7.15M Danbury property buy
item.description: An investor has purchased a four-building commercial property totaling 110,652 square feet on 21.8 acres in Danbury for $7.15 million, according to a broker involved in the deal and property […]

item.title: Lamont’s budget keeps commuter rail, bus service flat
item.description: Connecticut’s commuter rail and bus services will continue running at current levels for the next year under Gov. Ned Lamont’s latest budget proposal, which otherwise warned of an impending fiscal cliff due to loss of pandemic-era federal funding for rail.

item.title: 🔒 Downtown New Haven mixed-use building anchored by Olives and Oil sells for $3.65M
item.description: Downtown New Haven mixed-use building anchored by Olive and Oil sells for $3.65M

item.title: Jordan’s Furniture makes a March Madness sales bet on UConn
item.description: Jordan’s Furniture is known for its wacky marketing campaigns, but fans of the University of Connecticut men’s and women’s basketball teams may view its latest as a slam dunk.

item.title: 🔒 Major CT manufacturer announces board chair succession plan
item.description: Wallingford manufacturer Amphenol Corp. said its board of directors has approved a leadership succession plan that will shift the company’s chairmanship in May.

item.title: CVS Health-Aetna laying off 313 remote workers, 17 in CT
item.description: CVS Health plans to lay off more than 300 additional workers at Hartford health insurer Aetna, including 17 in Connecticut, by the end of July, raising the total number of layoffs in the past two years to more than 1,000 workers.

item.title: 🔒 Cigna posts strong earnings as FTC lawsuit settlement announced
item.description: The Federal Trade Commission (FTC) on Wednesday announced a settlement with Express Scripts Inc., one of the nation’s largest pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs).

item.title: 🔒 Bob’s Discount Furniture set to begin trading after $331M IPO
item.description: Manchester-based Bob’s Discount Furniture is scheduled to begin trading on the New York Stock Exchange on Thursday after raising $330.7 million in its initial public offering.

item.title: 🔒 Veradermics’ IPO raises $256M in stellar NYSE debut
item.description: Veradermics Inc., the New Haven drug developer working on an oral treatment for hair loss, raised $256.3 million from its initial public offering on Wednesday.
